The user wants to restore the cursor position, open files, and panel visibility when reopening a project.
I have a plan with 4 phases:
1. [fallo] A locator: dónde se guarda la posición del cursor al cerrar el proyecto
2. [en_curso] B locator: dónde se restaura la posición del cursor al abrir el proyecto
3. [pendiente] C locator: dónde se guarda y restaura la visibilidad de los paneles laterales
4. [pendiente] P puente: hay un mecanismo común que orquesta la persistencia de todo el estado del editor (need A B C)

Work done:
T1: Asked about saving/restoring editor state. Read: save state, reset to single cursor, reset helix editor state.
T2: Asked about saving cursor position on close. Read: save, save workspace session, save buffer. Conclusion: save serializes open tabs and active tab path, but NOT cursor position (offset/line/col). Cursor position found belongs to search panel/text input, not main editor.
T3: Asked about restoring cursor position on open. Read: restore workspace session, open file.
